intro: Good evening, gentlemen. Gameweek 4 is done. Results included Aston Villa 1-2 Nott'm Forest, Bournemouth 2-2 Brentford and Chelsea 2-2 Hull City. Josh top-scored with 74; Jamie managed 18. Asher leads on 220, 15 clear of Ben. Josh climbs 3 to 3rd. Make of that what you will.
motw: Josh scored 74, the best of the week. Schade (15), João Pedro (12) and A.Becker (9) did the heavy lifting. Now 3rd on 194.
stinker: 18 points. That's the lot. Kelleher top-scored with 3, which tells you how the rest went.
bench: 15 points left on the bench. Horníček (1), Igor Jesus (7), Maguire (1) and Rúben (6) watched from the side. Team selection remains an art, not a science.
bench_jam: Georginio didn't play, so Branthwaite came off Josh's bench and scored 6. A clean sheet. Luck is a skill if you say it confidently.
red_card: Awoniyi (Coventry City) returned -2 for Ben. Featuring a red card.
